parameters.name: Report
parameters.description: Explorer fields to report for each matching host. Empty prints the matching hostnames.

parameters.name: Hosts
parameters.description: Limit the query to these hosts. Leave empty to use every host.

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: Hosts carrying any of these cdist inventory tags.

parameters.name: AllTags
parameters.description: Hosts carrying all of these cdist inventory tags.

parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: The expression to run, e.g. 'distro == debian and cpu_cores gt 1'. Usually prefilled by the query builder.
